install_startup.recipe_modification_note: No Dockerfile or compose file ships with this project - it's a pure Vite/pnpm monorepo, meant to be run locally with `pnpm dev` or `pnpm build && pnpm preview` per its own README. Wrote a multi-stage Dockerfile matching that: builder stage runs pnpm install (pnpm 11.7.0 via corepack, needs node 22 - the project's own pnpm version requires it) and pnpm build; final stage copies only the built apps/web/dist static output and serves it with `serve`, discarding the builder's node_modules (multi-GB - huggingface/transformers, three.js, onnxruntime, etc. - which is what exhausted this sandbox's disk when first tried as a single-stage image, no different from a normal SPA production deploy).
